source_identity: Modified and newly introduced implementation files are identified by input_sha256. Unchanged files come from tested_source_base. This result is carried by the final source commit.

upstream_reference.comparison: Source/UI reference plus previously recorded isolated original observations; no complete new original-binary differential run.

workspace_all_targets.ignored_reason: Four existing helper-process entry points intentionally invoked by parent tests.

cli_build.profile: dev, debug=0; not a release package

real_secret_service.isolation: Private XDG directories and dedicated dbus-run-session/gnome-keyring-daemon, synthetic credentials and loopback HTTP, proxy inheritance disabled.

desktop_lib.ignored_reason: One existing optional native Codex worker entry point. Its external native-client coordinator was not rerun in this iteration; the isolated CLI process protocol/cancel/reap test runs and passed.

local_elf_dependency.scope: Existing locally built debug CLI; no Release package built.
